name: SUNWAY
recent: Sunway 于 2026 年 11 月 6 日召开特别股东大会，通过设立最多占已发行股份 10% 的 ESOS 及分配期权给多名董事的议案。同期，雇员公积金局（EPF）在 9 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。最新财报显示 2026 年 6 月季度营收同比增长 13.4%，但净利润环比大幅下滑 96.6%。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会通过设立最多 10% 已发行股份的 ESOS，并批准分配期权给包括 Tan Sri Dato' Seri Dr. Jeffrey Cheah Fook Ling 在内的多名董事。
Bursa Securities 于 2026 年 10 月 19 日批准 Sunway 拟议 ESOS 下最多 10% 新股的上市与报价。
EPF 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报作为主要股东的持股变动。
risks: ESOS 最多可发行相当于已发行股份 10% 的新股，可能带来股权摊薄。
最新季度净利润环比大幅下降 96.6%。

recent_en: Sunway held an EGM on 6 Nov 2026 where shareholders approved the establishment of an ESOS of up to 10% of issued shares and the allocation of options to several directors. Meanwhile, the Employees Provident Fund Board reported multiple changes in its shareholding between September and November. The latest quarterly results showed revenue up 13.4% year-on-year for the quarter ended June 2026, while net profit fell 96.6% quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Shareholders at the EGM approved the establishment of an ESOS of up to 10% of issued shares and the allocation of options to several directors including Tan Sri Dato' Seri Dr. Jeffrey Cheah Fook Ling.
Bursa Securities approved on 19 Oct 2026 the listing and quotation of up to 10% new shares under Sunway's proposed ESOS.
EPF reported multiple changes in its substantial shareholder holdings between September and November 2026.
risks_en: The ESOS may issue new shares of up to 10% of issued shares, potentially causing shareholding dilution.
Net profit fell 96.6% quarter-on-quarter in the latest quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended June 2026, revenue was MYR 2,905,669,000, up 13.4% year-on-year and 13.6% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 318,587,000, up 16.7% year-on-year but down 96.6% quarter-on-quarter. Net margin was 11.0% versus 368.1% in the previous quarter.
